data.name: Dialogs_ClearTerrainCache_Message
data.value: Cached terrain and terrain-classification data will be removed and downloaded again when needed. Saved locations and settings are not affected.

data.name: Dialogs_RefreshSettlement_Message_Format
data.value: Rebuild WSF settlement layers for all {0} saved locations without redownloading base maps or road and water data?
data.comment: {0} is the number of saved locations.

data.name: Dialogs_RegenerateMapImages_Message_Format
data.value: Download fresh raster maps and road and water overlays for all {0} saved locations? Shared environmental tiles will be reused.
data.comment: {0} is the number of saved locations.

data.name: Dialogs_RemoveAtlas_Message
data.value: The installed atlas data will be deleted. The light pollution overlay will be unavailable until it is installed again, which downloads it anew.

data.name: Dialogs_RemoveCamera_Unnamed_Message
data.value: This camera will be removed from your equipment.

data.name: Dialogs_RemoveEquipment_Named_Message
data.value: “{0}” will be removed from your equipment.
data.comment: {0} is the camera or lens name.

data.name: Dialogs_RemoveLens_Unnamed_Message
data.value: This lens will be removed from your equipment.

data.name: Dialogs_RestoreDefaultObjects_Message
data.value: Your configured celestial objects will be replaced by the Sun and the Moon.
